User Story Description: As a prospective client exploring HRMS platforms, I want to explore base plans, view detailed feature sets, and request a sales-assisted custom plan, so that I can choose a package suited to my company size.
Business Value: Enables conversion of visitors into leads and facilitates custom sales deals.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a visitor is on the marketing page
**WHEN** they click on 'Request Custom Plan'
**THEN** a modal form must capture Name, Email, Company Size, Phone, and Required Modules.
**AND** saving the form must store a Lead record and notify the Sales team.

User Story Description: As an HR manager registering my company, I want to submit my company profile, enter identity details (CIN, GSTIN, director DIN, signing authority), and book a demo call, so that I can initialize onboarding compliance.
Business Value: Establishes corporate identity and compliance vetting before activating financial features.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a registering HR admin
**WHEN** they fill in the signup form
**THEN** the system must validate that the CIN is exactly 21 characters and GSTIN is 15 characters.
**AND** the scheduled demo call date must be in the future.
**AND** the tenant status is set to PENDING_KYC.

Story Title: Super Admin Verification Dashboard & KYC Maker-Checker
User Story Description: As a Super Admin, I want to view all companies with pending KYC status, verify their documents, and update their compliance status with remarks, so that I can grant them full system access.
Business Value: Ensures only legally verified entities can use financial and payroll systems, mitigating fraud.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a logged-in Super Admin
**WHEN** they access the platform admin dashboard
**THEN** they can view pending KYC applications.
**AND** clicking 'Approve' updates company kycStatus to APPROVED.
**AND** clicking 'Reject' requires inputting remarks and updates kycStatus to REJECTED.

User Story Description: As a newly approved tenant company, I want my 30-day free trial subscription to activate automatically upon KYC approval, so that my team can immediately access the system.
Business Value: Reduces time-to-value for new customers and drives trial conversions.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a company has been approved for KYC
**WHEN** the kycStatus transitions to APPROVED
**THEN** the system must auto-generate an ACTIVE subscription.
**AND** set the subscription endDate to exactly 30 days from the approval date.
**AND** block subsequent free trial generations for the same company CIN.

User Story Description: As an HR Admin, I want to configure branch office physical locations with timezones and geofencing coordinates (latitude, longitude, radius), so that employee attendance can be geofenced.
Business Value: Allows accurate attendance geofencing across multiple geographical office locations.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a logged-in HR Admin
**WHEN** they add a branch location
**THEN** the form must validate latitude (range -90 to 90) and longitude (range -180 to 180).
**AND** the geofence radius must be set in meters.
**AND** timezone must map to a valid IANA timezone identifier.

User Story Description: As an HR Admin, I want to create company departments and onboard employees, linking them to their direct managers, so that our organizational reporting structure is defined.
Business Value: Establishes organizational hierarchy, enabling routing of approval workflows (leave, expenses).
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a logged-in HR Admin
**WHEN** they onboard a new employee
**THEN** they can assign them to a department.
**AND** select a reporting manager from existing employees.
**AND** the system must prevent self-parenting (managerId cannot be the employee's own ID).

User Story Description: As a Payroll Admin, I want to define basic salary, HRA, DA, conveyance, medical allowances, and toggle statutory options (PF, TDS, PT) for each employee, so that payroll calculations are correct.
Business Value: Enables automated, accurate, and customized monthly salary computations per employee.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a logged-in Payroll Admin
**WHEN** they edit an employee's salary structure
**THEN** basicSalary must be configured (typically 50% of gross).
**AND** enabling PF must apply standard EPF calculation models (12% of basic + DA).
**AND** enabling TDS must configure tax deductions based on the employee's tax regime.

User Story Description: As an employee, I want to log check-in and check-out timestamps using my GPS coordinates when I am inside the office branch geofence boundary, so that my work hours are tracked.
Business Value: Automates tracking of hours worked and prevents time-theft through geofence validation.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** an employee checks in via mobile
**WHEN** their distance from the assigned branch coordinates is computed using the Haversine formula
**THEN** if the distance is within the office radius, the check-in succeeds.
**AND** if the distance exceeds the radius, the check-in is blocked (403 error).

User Story Description: As an employee, I want to view my remaining leave balances (casual, sick, annual) and apply for leaves, so that my absences are recorded against my yearly limits.
Business Value: Prevents excessive unpaid leaves and automates leave tracking.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** an employee applies for leave
**WHEN** the requested leave period is calculated in days
**THEN** the system must verify it is less than or equal to the remaining leave balance.
**AND** if balance is sufficient, create request in PENDING state.
**AND** update quota balance only upon successful approval.

User Story Description: As a Manager, I want to view pending leave requests of my direct reports and approve or reject them, so that I can maintain department staffing.
Business Value: Ensures managers can handle workforce planning and control leaves of absence.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a logged-in Manager
**WHEN** they access the leave approvals center
**THEN** they can view leave requests from direct reports only (where employee's managerId = manager's ID).
**AND** approving updates the request status to APPROVED and triggers balance reduction.

User Story Description: As a Payroll Admin, I want to confirm a list of manual payroll checks (attendance locked, revisions reviewed, tax declarations, arrears checked) before running payroll, so that errors are caught early.
Business Value: Acts as a safety gate to ensure payroll administrators verify input data accuracy.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a Payroll Admin starting a payroll run
**WHEN** they submit the payroll run request
**THEN** the API must verify that all 10 checkboxes (confirmations) are marked as true.
**AND** the system must check that every active employee has an associated salary structure.

User Story Description: As a Finance Manager, I want to transition the monthly payroll run through Draft, Reviewed, Approved, and Processed stages, so that maker-checker segregation of duties is maintained.
Business Value: Ensures financial accountability and dual-authorization before payroll funds are released.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a payroll run is initiated
**WHEN** the run goes through stages
**THEN** only DRAFT runs can transition to REVIEWED.
**AND** only REVIEWED runs can transition to APPROVED.
**AND** only APPROVED runs can transition to PROCESSED.
**AND** processing must freeze database records from further modification.

User Story Description: As a Compliance Admin, I want to export monthly PF and ESIC Electronic Challenge cum Return (ECR) files, so that our company complies with national labor regulations.
Business Value: Automates compliance returns and avoids penalty assessments for the tenant organization.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a finalized payroll run (status PROCESSED)
**WHEN** the compliance officer clicks export ECR
**THEN** the system must generate a CSV containing UAN, gross wages, EPF wages, and employer/employee PF contribution details.
**AND** exclude employees earning over 21,000 INR from the ESIC report.

User Story Description: As a Tenant Admin, I want to enforce strict role-based endpoints (Admin, Payroll, Manager, Employee), so that unauthorized employees cannot view sensitive payroll or company data.
Business Value: Secures enterprise payroll and employee PII, adhering to security guidelines.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** an authenticated user
**WHEN** they request an API endpoint (e.g. GET /api/reports/export)
**THEN** the middleware must check their role permissions.
**AND** reject requests with 403 Forbidden if the user's role is not authorized.

User Story Description: As a Sales Person, I want to create a custom pricing plan and toggle specific features for a client company, so that we can close customized sales contracts.
Business Value: Increases sales agility and supports flexible product pricing.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Details):
**GIVEN** a logged-in Sales Person
**WHEN** they configure a custom plan for a tenant
**THEN** they can select specific active modules (e.g. disable Payroll, enable Attendance).
**AND** saving custom plan updates the company's subscription capabilities.
**AND** company sidebars must hide disabled modules.
